message.reasoning_content: We need to answer: Which Black Eyed Peas single, released June 2003 as lead single from third album Elephunk, has scenes of Postal 2 in its music video? Also evidence about "Where Is the Love?" says it's a song released June 2003 as lead single from Elephunk. So answer: "Where Is the Love?"
